Create a 14-day plan for learning the fundamentals of machine learning from scratch.

CONSTRAINTS:

Here is a detailed 14-day beginner machine learning learning plan that satisfies all your constraints and success criteria. The plan balances theory and practical exercises, covers all required topics, and reserves the final two days for revision and a small project.

---

### **14-Day Beginner Machine Learning Learning Plan**

#### **Day 1: Introduction to Machine Learning**
- **Theory:**
  - What is machine learning?
  - Types of machine learning (supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement learning)
  - Common applications of ML
- **Practical:**
  - Set up Python environment (Jupyter Notebook, Anaconda, or VS Code)
  - Install essential libraries (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn)
- **Resources:**
  - [Scikit-learn Introduction](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/getting_started.html)
  - [Kaggle Python for Data Science](https://www.kaggle.com/learn/python)

---

#### **Day 2: Python for Machine Learning**
- **Theory:**
  - Python basics (variables, loops, functions, lists, dictionaries)
  - Working with NumPy arrays
- **Practical:**
  - Write simple Python scripts for data manipulation
  - Practice basic NumPy operations
- **Resources:**
  - [Python for Beginners](https://www.w3schools.com/python/)
  - [NumPy Tutorial](https://numpy.org/doc/stable/user/quickstart.html)

---

#### **Day 3: Data Preprocessing**
- **Theory:**
  - What is data preprocessing?
  - Handling missing values, outliers, and categorical data
  - Feature scaling (Normalization, Standardization)
- **Practical:**
  - Load a dataset (e.g., Iris or Titanic dataset)
  - Clean and preprocess the data using Pandas and Scikit-learn
- **Resources:**
  - [Scikit-learn Data Preprocessing](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/preprocessing.html)
  - [Kaggle Data Preprocessing Tutorial](https://www.kaggle.com/learn/preprocessing)

---

#### **Day 4: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)**
- **Theory:**
  - Visualizing data (histograms, scatter plots, box plots)
  - Summarizing data (mean, median, standard deviation)
- **Practical:**
  - Perform EDA on your dataset using Matplotlib and Seaborn
  - Generate visualizations and summarize key statistics
- **Resources:**
  - [Seaborn Tutorial](https://seaborn.pydata.org/tutorial.html)
  - [EDA Guide](https://realpython.com/beginner-friendly-data-analysis-with-python/)

---

#### **Day 5: Introduction to Supervised Learning**
- **Theory:**
  - What is supervised learning?
  - Types of supervised learning (regression, classification)
  - Overview of common algorithms (Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Trees)
- **Practical:**
  - Understand the structure of supervised learning problems
- **Resources:**
  - [Scikit-learn Supervised Learning](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/supervised_learning.html)
  - [Kaggle Supervised Learning](https://www.kaggle.com/learn/intro-to-ml)

---

#### **Day 6: Linear Regression**
- **Theory:**
  - What is linear regression?
  - Cost function and gradient descent
  - Model evaluation metrics (MSE, RMSE, R²)
- **Practical:**
  - Implement linear regression on a dataset (e.g., Boston Housing)
  - Evaluate the model using appropriate metrics
- **Resources:**
  - [Scikit-learn Linear Regression](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.linear_model.LinearRegression.html)
  - [Linear Regression Tutorial](https://www.kaggle.com/learn/linear-regression)

---

#### **Day 7: Logistic Regression**
- **Theory:**
  - What is logistic regression?
  - Sigmoid function and classification
  - Model evaluation metrics (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-score)
- **Practical:**
  - Implement logistic regression on a classification dataset (e.g., Iris)
  - Evaluate the model using classification metrics
- **Resources:**
  - [Scikit-learn Logistic Regression](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.linear_model.LogisticRegression.html)
  - [Logistic Regression Tutorial](https://www.kaggle.com/learn/logistic-regression)

---

#### **Day 8: Model Evaluation and Metrics**
- **Theory:**
  - Cross-validation (k-fold cross-validation)
  - Confusion matrix
  - Precision, recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC
- **Practical:**
  - Evaluate models using cross-validation and various metrics
  - Compare performance of different models
- **Resources:**
  - [Scikit-learn Model Evaluation](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/model_evaluation.html)
  - [Model Evaluation Guide](https://machinelearningmastery.com/evaluation-metrics-classification-model/)

---

#### **Day 9: Decision Trees**
- **Theory:**
  - What are decision trees?
  - Splitting criteria (Gini impurity, entropy)
  - Pruning and overfitting
- **Practical:**
  - Implement a decision tree on a classification dataset
  - Visualize the decision tree
- **Resources:**
  - [Scikit-learn Decision Tree](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.tree.DecisionTreeClassifier.html)
  - [Decision Trees Tutorial](https://www.kaggle.com/learn/decision-trees)

---

#### **Day 10: Introduction to Unsupervised Learning**
- **Theory:**
  - What is unsupervised learning?
  - Clustering vs. dimensionality reduction
  - Common algorithms (K-Means, PCA)
- **Practical:**
  - Understand the structure of unsupervised learning problems
- **Resources:**
  - [Scikit-learn Unsupervised Learning](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/unsupervised.html)
  - [Kaggle Unsupervised Learning](https://www.kaggle.com/learn/unsupervised-learning)

---

#### **Day 11: K-Means Clustering**
- **Theory:**
  - What is K-Means clustering?
  - Elbow method and inertia
  - Choosing the optimal number of clusters
- **Practical:**
  - Implement K-Means clustering on a dataset (e.g., Iris or customer segmentation)
  - Visualize the clusters
- **Resources:**
  - [Scikit-learn K-Means](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.cluster.KMeans.html)
  - [K-Means Tutorial](https://www.kaggle.com/learn/k-means-clustering)

---

#### **Day 12: Dimensionality Reduction (PCA)**
- **Theory:**
  - What is PCA?
  - Eigenvalues and eigenvectors
  - Explained variance ratio
- **Practical:**
  - Apply PCA to a dataset
  - Visualize the reduced-dimensionality data
- **Resources:**
  - [Scikit-learn PCA](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.decomposition.PCA.html)
  - [PCA Tutorial](https://www.kaggle.com/learn/pca)

---

#### **Day 13: Revision and Recap**
- **Theory:**
  - Recap all topics covered (Python, data preprocessing, supervised learning, unsupervised learning, model evaluation)
  - Review key concepts and algorithms
- **Practical:**
  - Revisit previous exercises and reinforce learning
- **Resources:**
  - Revisit all previous tutorials and resources

---

#### **Day 14: Small Project**
- **Project:**
  - Choose a dataset (e.g., from Kaggle or UCI ML Repository)
  - Perform end-to-end machine learning:
    - Data preprocessing and EDA
    - Train a supervised or unsupervised learning model
    - Evaluate the model and interpret results
  - Write a short report or Jupyter Notebook summarizing the process and findings
- **Resources:**
  - [Kaggle Datasets](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets)
  - [UCI ML Repository](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/index.php)

---

This plan ensures that you cover all the required topics, include both theory and practical exercises, and reserve the final two days for revision and a small project.
